decision.escalation_reason: High-risk factor detected ('price war') — requires CMO ratification.
decision.rationale: Given the observed price strings in our source snapshots and Nebius's known hardware mentions, engaging in a direct price war risks margin compression without capitalizing on our established brand positioning. Grounding the B200 launch message in our existing simplicity and scaling narrative avoids unverified price-to-performance claims while differentiating our go-to-market approach.
decision.risks: Risk of lower initial market capture if competitors aggressively undercut on headline pricing, requiring close human review of competitive deal responses.
